narrative: Jascha Martschenko contributed to TrueSight DAO from October 2020 to June 2023, with primary focus on recruitment and marketing efforts. He brought on three active contributors through the Bring Builders initiative, recruited two key opinion leaders, and one resource owner. Jascha created and posted three marketing videos to YouTube or TikTok under Build Game - Marketing, provided two UX suggestions and two pieces of reference material for strategy, and raised one governance concern about a minor issue. His top categories include bringing builders (six contributions) and marketing video production (three).
